findings.description: Finish is not idempotent for the intended timeout-retry sequence. If the first call successfully stores "done" but its response times out, the retry reads the completed job and returns ErrAlreadyFinished, so the worker can never confirm successful delivery and may continue retrying or report failure.

summary: The new Finish implementation rejects the explicitly intended duplicate call after a successful-but-timed-out first call. No other substantiated material issues were found.
risk_rationale: The defect occurs directly in the authoritative intended usage and turns a successfully persisted finish report into a persistent error from the worker's perspective.
